findings.comment: The English material note (N4) specifies a finish of 'IZBP', while the corresponding French note (N5) lists the finish as 'N.A.' (Not Applicable). This contradiction creates ambiguity for manufacturing and inspection regarding the required surface treatment. The designer must align both notes to specify the same finish requirement.
findings.recommended_correction: Update note N5 to match N4 ('IZBP') or clarify if no finish is required in both languages.
